notes: • Roof: TJI 230 at 24" o.c., milled LSL ridge plate. LSTA18, H8 primary.
• Bay: 5" ccSPF on deck, R-30C batt. Foam is the air and vapour barrier.
• Deck: 19/32" CDX, 40/20, oversailing the rafter ends to the girt face.
• Butyl membrane 240 F, full field + eave strip-in. 24 ga Image II, nail flange.
• Wall: 2x6, 1/2" ply, 4" ccSPF, 1/2" gap, KDAT girts, 1-1/4" PBR. No WRB.
• Birdsmouth: heel at plate outer face, 2-1/2" seat, 1-1/4" cut. 7/8" beveled stiffeners both sides. H8 each rafter.
• 2x6 eave block on edge on the plate, every bay. ccSPF over it.
• Wall foam tight to the deck underside: closed-cell fill. No high-expansion foam.
• Membrane to deck edge; gutter flange, then eave leg, on it. Bearing 2.04".
• Strip-in over both flanges, 4" past the hem. 6403899 tape on it; pan over it.
• PBR 5x4 gutter, level, back behind eave face, flange under eave leg.
• Eave face over the gutter back, hemmed into the trough; pan hemmed round the lip, 64032XX bead in the hem.
• 2x6 girt on 3-2x6 standoffs, 2 TLOK08 each. Hanger below the eave face; bracket pending.
